title: Chennai Tour Packages: Best 1-Day Sightseeing, Temple & Outstation Trips (2026)
excerpt: Explore the best Chennai tour packages for families, couples & groups. Covers 1-day Chennai city sightseeing, Mahabalipuram, Pondicherry, Tirupati, Kanchipuram, Rameswaram, Ooty & Kodaikanal.
description: Book customized Chennai tour packages with SR Tours & Travels. 1-day Chennai sightseeing, Tirupati, Mahabalipuram, Pondicherry, Rameswaram, Ooty & Kodaikanal packages in AC vehicles.
html:
From centuries-old Dravidian temples and golden beaches to misty Western Ghats hill stations just a comfortable drive away, Chennai is the ultimate gateway to South India. At SR Tours & Travels, our Chennai tour packages are crafted for families, senior citizens, honeymooners, and corporate teams who want private AC vehicles and zero itinerary stress.

1. Popular 1-Day Chennai City Sightseeing Package

Discover the cultural heart of Chennai in a single well-paced day with doorstep pickup and drop:

  • Kapaleeshwarar Temple (Mylapore) & Parthasarathy Temple: Iconic Pallava & Vijayanagara temple architecture.
  • Marina Beach & Santhome Cathedral Basilica: Scenic coastal drive and heritage landmarks.
  • Government Museum (Egmore) & Fort St. George: Rich South Indian bronzes and colonial history.
  • Guindy National Park / Vandalur Zoo & Besant Nagar Beach: Perfect afternoon & sunset stops for families and kids.

3. Choosing the Right Vehicle for Your Chennai Tour Package

  • 2–4 Travellers: AC Swift Dzire or Toyota Etios Sedan.
  • 5–7 Travellers: Toyota Innova, Innova Crysta, or Innova Hycross for extra legroom and luggage space.
  • 8–18 Travellers: AC Push-back Tempo Traveller for joint families, weddings, and corporate outings.

Check full vehicle options on our Vehicle page or view rates on our Tariff page.

4. Frequently Asked Questions – Chennai Tour Packages

Can I customize my Chennai tour package itinerary?

Yes! Every tour package with SR Tours is 100% private and customizable — you choose your pickup time, stops, and vehicle type.

Do you pick up from Chennai Airport, Central, or Egmore Railway Station?

Yes, we offer 24/7 pickup from Chennai Airport (MAA), Chennai Central, Egmore, Tambaram, and any home or hotel in Chennai.

Ready to plan your trip? Call +91 9884300373 / 9884050506 or request a free quote online.
